title: fix(types): the @object-ui/types/zod mirrors keep an unknown key instead of silently dropping it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNzn2LZs8bk8QMmkCUnkJdy)_

Part of #25923 — work item 2 (strip-mode mirrors) only. Items 1 (the flat calendar / gantt keys) and 3 (the `options` bag, which needs the stored-row census first) stay on the card for later dispatches, and #25923 remains open after this merges.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The `@object-ui/types/zod` mirrors held strip-mode objects (plain `z.object()`): a misspelled key parsed green and was silently dropped, so `FormFieldSchema.safeParse({ name, type, labell: 'oops' })` succeeded with `labell` gone, while `@objectstack/spec` refuses it by name. Every one of them is now `.passthrough()` (`z.looseObject`), like `BaseSchema` already was. The strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema` / `deriveStrictAuthoringSchema`, what `objectui validate` uses) is unchanged and still refuses an unknown key by name, so the two faces now disagree only on keep-or-refuse, never on silently dropping.

### Re-measured with the card's probe

| reading | before (base `38050ced`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `*Schema` exports of `index.zod.ts` in strip mode (the card's probe) | **67** (the card said 74, the static scan 63) | **1** |
| strip-mode object nodes reachable from those exports, local to `ui/packages/types` | 157 | 3 |
| `z.object(` call sites in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/*.zod.ts` converted | — | 145 |

The one remaining strip export is `HttpRequestSchema`, and the three remaining reachable nodes (`HttpRequestSchema`, the `$and`/`$or`/`$not` filter group, a filter-field object) are all spec-derived clones made by `stripImportedDefaults` from `@objectstack/spec` subschemas: they are not authored in this package, `HttpRequestSchema` is already in the parity file's `EXCLUSIONS`, and the new census reads source sites, which they are not.

### Landing point

As expected by the card: `ui/packages/types/src/zod/*.zod.ts` (16 files) and `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`. No producer lives outside the package.

### The guard (beside `assertionNoVacuousEntry`)

A new `describe` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, "no object in ../zod/ strips an unknown key (objectstack#25923)":

- an AST census of every `z.object` / `z.looseObject` / `z.strictObject` call in `../zod/`, classifying each by its method chain (`.passthrough()`, `.strict()`, `.strip()`, `.catchall()`), fails on any site whose mode is strip;
- a non-vacuity pin (more than 100 loose sites, one in `form.zod.ts`, at least one strict site);
- a runtime pin that no registered `MIRRORS` value is an object with an undefined catchall.

It is runtime, not a type-level `assertion…` like its neighbour, and the docblock says why: zod 4 types `$strip` and `$strict` identically, so a type-level "no strip" pin cannot tell them apart (measured: it flagged exactly the five strict entries). This is the existing instrument the card named, not a new gate.

### Type-surface consequence, and how the pins absorb it

zod 4 gives a passthrough object's `z.input` / `z.infer` a `[k: string]: unknown` index signature. A declared `interface` is not assignable to a type carrying one, so the parity file's narrower-direction pin read every nested object member as narrower than its declaration (22 pins went red). The fix is one test-only operator, `WithoutCatchall` (`ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-catchall-type.ts`), which removes exactly that signature (an index signature of `unknown` on an object that also has literal keys) and is the identity everywhere else. It is applied to the narrower direction only (`AcceptedOf`), so the wider direction still compares the raw input. `KnownDrift` moves from 55 entries / 93 keys to 53 / 90: `AppSchemaRendererNodeSchema` and `ReportSectionSchema` leave the ledger, `DashboardWidgetSchema` and `ReportComponentSchema` change their keys, each with a "LEFT / JOINED under objectstack#25923" note.

Downstream: `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter='...@object-ui/types'` was 112/112 tasks green with the passthrough mirrors.

## Held back: the `FormField` index signature in `form.ts`

The card also recommends dropping `FormField`'s `[key: string]: any`. It was measured on this branch and reverted, because it breaks consumers outside this dispatch's file surface:

- `@object-ui/components` `src/renderers/form/form.tsx` lines 1884, 1959, 2055, 2195, 3228: `FormField` is not assignable to `FieldWithDeclaredDefault` (index signature missing);
- `@object-ui/plugin-form` `src/ObjectForm.tsx:1068` writes `group`, which `FormField` does not declare; `src/WizardForm.tsx:845`, the same `FieldWithDeclaredDefault` error;
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` `src/ObjectGrid.tsx` lines 5963 and 6016, plus the type-check cascade of every package depending on those.

Removing a published index signature also narrows what a TypeScript caller may write on `FormField`, so it is a `(narrowing)` Clause-② change on its own. It is reported to the seat as an open question rather than folded in here; `form.ts` is unchanged in this PR.

## File surface beyond the claim

The claim named the strip-mode zod files, `form.ts`, the parity test and one changeset. The diff also touches:

- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-catchall-type.ts` (new, test-only; excluded from the build) and five sibling type tests that compare `z.input` with a declaration and now read it through the same operator (`ai-zod-arms-10859`, `designer-zod-arms-10859`, `registered-type-arms-10859-b2`, `sort-string-arm-retired-8221`, `base-schema-predicate-envelope-7530`);
- 18 `ui/packages/types` tests that pinned the old strip behaviour ("the unknown key is dropped") and now pin passthrough ("the key is kept and still not refused"), each with a comment citing objectstack#25923;
- two consumer tests that used the strip as their measuring instrument ("parse and see which keys survive"), now measured with the strict twin (`deriveStrictAuthoringSchema`), which refuses an undeclared key by name: `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/component-fixture-declared-keys.test.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/columnCollapsedHonoured-9628.test.tsx`;
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: the registry-source digest moves because the registry sources changed; `sdui.manifest.json` itself is byte-identical.

Each of these is a consequence of the mirrors no longer stripping; none changes runtime code outside `ui/packages/types/src/zod/`.

## Verification

All on the final head `0d70f7e3` (branch merged with `main` at `6a6ebff9`); tests and type-checks ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/` plus the 120 `ui/` test files that import `@object-ui/types/zod` or a mirror schema: **510 files, 12867 tests, all passed**. Before the two instrument tests moved to the strict twin, that consumer set read 118 passed, 2 failed (5 tests). The full consumer battery is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0. Downstream `turbo run type-check --filter='...@object-ui/types'`: 112/112 tasks successful (pre-merge head); `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` type-check clean after the test edits.
- The derived gate union (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 46 commands): all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- Spec-owned strip nodes: the reachability walk also counts 18 strip-mode object nodes inside `@objectstack/spec` subschemas that the mirrors import by reference. They are the spec's, not this package's, and are out of scope here.
- `exportConfigs` residue: `WithoutCatchall` does not walk into an object that has no catchall of its own (a partial record keyed by export format), because walking those was measured to hit TS2589 on the node tree. The residue is ledgered in `KnownDrift` on `ReportComponentSchema`, `ReportBuilderSchema` and `ReportViewerSchema`.
- `ObjectForm.tsx:1068` writing an undeclared `group` key on a `FormField` is only visible once the index signature goes; it belongs to the `FormField` follow-up above.

Serial note: #25926 waits for this PR, because both edit `ui/packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts`.
